rules.title: Harsh gradients
rules.required_behavior: Remove conspicuous multi-stop gradients. Use material, texture, borders, images, or restrained flat surfaces with intentional contrast.
rules.detection: Strong/multi-stop CSS gradients; screenshot review
rules.remedy: Replace decorative harsh gradients with purposeful flat/layered composition.

rules.title: Lucide icons
rules.required_behavior: Do not add Lucide or use `lucide-react` as a default icon shortcut. Replace generic decorative instances with purposeful custom SVG, licensed iconography, or meaningful text.
rules.detection: Imports and usage from Lucide packages
rules.remedy: Replace with product-appropriate custom/approved icon or text; avoid arbitrary icon substitution.

rules.title: Pure white backgrounds
rules.required_behavior: Avoid full-page `#FFFFFF` / `rgb(255 255 255)` backgrounds. Use considered off-white or tinted neutral surfaces; preserve necessary contrast.
rules.detection: Root/body pure-white background and computed styles
rules.remedy: Introduce deliberate neutral surface token; verify contrast.

rules.title: Rainbow coloring
rules.required_behavior: Avoid using many unrelated accent hues. Build a curated, intentional palette.
rules.detection: Excess number of unrelated accent hues
rules.remedy: Consolidate into curated accent roles, preserving actual data visualizations.

rules.title: Purple or dark gradients
rules.required_behavior: Do not use generic purple glows or dark gradient hero backgrounds.
rules.detection: Purple gradients and dark-gradient hero combinations
rules.remedy: Remove generic gradient effect; preserve brand-approved colors.

rules.title: Drop shadows
rules.required_behavior: Remove template-style large, soft, floating shadows. Establish depth through spacing, borders, layered surfaces, and hierarchy.
rules.detection: Large repeated CSS box shadows
rules.remedy: Shift separation to borders, spacing, tone, and hierarchy.

rules.title: Three feature cards in a row
rules.required_behavior: Do not default to the predictable three-across feature section. Use product-led layouts, editorial sections, real screenshots, or purposeful asymmetry.
rules.detection: Repeated 3-column marketing-card groups
rules.remedy: Refactor into content-led layout and actual product evidence.

rules.title: Liquid glass
rules.required_behavior: Avoid frosted acrylic, glassmorphism, oversized backdrop blurs, and translucent glass panels as a theme.
rules.detection: `backdrop-filter`, translucent glass UI, blurred panels
rules.remedy: Remove glass treatment and use solid, legible surfaces.

rules.title: Em dashes
rules.required_behavior: Do not generate em dashes (`—`) in visible interface or marketing copy. Rewrite sentences naturally using a period, colon, or comma.
rules.detection: Unicode em dash in UI text, JSX literals, and content strings
rules.remedy: Rewrite sentence naturally without an em dash.

rules.title: Inter / Geist / Space Grotesk
rules.required_behavior: Do not choose these as the automatic typography stack. Select a distinctive, suitable, licensed font or a considered system stack.
rules.detection: Font imports or stacks defaulting to Inter, Geist, Space Grotesk
rules.remedy: Suggest or implement approved replacement with appropriate fallbacks.

rules.title: Colored left stripe
rules.required_behavior: Avoid generic colorful left-border callout cards. Use stronger information structure and restrained emphasis.
rules.detection: Accent-colored left borders on generic marketing blocks
rules.remedy: Replace with semantic grouping and restrained emphasis.

rules.title: Fake testimonials
rules.required_behavior: Never invent quotes, reviewers, company logos, numbers, or implied endorsements. Keep only verifiable, approved social proof.
rules.detection: Unverified testimonial and customer-logo claims
rules.remedy: Request provenance and approval; never automatically invent replacements.

rules.title: Bento grids
rules.required_behavior: Do not default to generic bento-grid feature layouts. Design for content and tasks instead.
rules.detection: Repetitive mixed-span bento feature-card template
rules.remedy: Move to product-led or editorial arrangement.

rules.title: Terminal windows
rules.required_behavior: Avoid faux command-line panels as decorative proof of technical sophistication. Only show an actual functioning technical interface when relevant.
rules.detection: Fake terminal chrome or code panel on nontechnical flow
rules.remedy: Replace with actual user-visible product UI where evidence exists.

rules.title: “It's not X, it's Y”
rules.required_behavior: Remove this stock rhetorical structure from generated copy. Explain concrete value instead.
rules.detection: Stock negation formula such as “not X, it's Y”
rules.remedy: Replace with direct, specific description of the benefit.

rules.title: Checkmark bullets
rules.required_behavior: Avoid repetitive green-check marketing lists. Use concise copy, actual product evidence, and conventional list styling where needed.
rules.detection: Green-check emoji/icons repeated as marketing bullets
rules.remedy: Use readable content, conventional bullets, or data-driven proof.

rules.title: Three pricing tiers
rules.required_behavior: Never generate three arbitrary pricing plans to fill a template. Preserve genuine business-configured plans, whatever their number.
rules.detection: Three pricing plans generated solely by template pattern
rules.remedy: Do not generate arbitrary plans; preserve source-of-truth pricing.

rules.title: No real product demos
rules.required_behavior: Product marketing must show a real captured UI, working preview, or verified demonstration when a demo is claimed. Never fabricate the UI or footage.
rules.detection: Demo CTA pointing to placeholder, mock UI, or nonfunctional target
rules.remedy: Connect to working demo or accurately label authentic preview; flag unresolved proof.

rules.title: Soft corner radius
rules.required_behavior: Avoid universally oversized rounded cards, buttons, and inputs. Use a controlled shape scale with generally sharper, practical corners.
rules.detection: Uniform, exaggerated border radius across components
rules.remedy: Normalize to a measured radius scale, preserving usability.

rules.title: Purple and black
rules.required_behavior: Avoid the clichéd purple-on-black AI-site aesthetic. Respect the product's actual branding instead.
rules.detection: Purple plus black default AI-site theme
rules.remedy: Replace aesthetic cliché with coherent product branding.

rules.title: No skeleton loader
rules.required_behavior: **Add appropriate loading states** for meaningful asynchronous regions. Use content-shaped skeletons when a real wait is expected, not decorative loading everywhere.
rules.detection: Asynchronous content with missing visible loading treatment
rules.remedy: Implement proportional skeleton or equivalent appropriate progress state plus error/empty states.

rules.title: Radial orbs
rules.required_behavior: Remove glowing decorative orbs, blurred radial color blobs, and empty atmospheric effects.
rules.detection: CSS blurred gradient orbs and radial glow ornaments
rules.remedy: Remove unnecessary orbital decoration.

rules.title: Dot grids
rules.required_behavior: Avoid background dot grids as generic tech decoration.
rules.detection: Repeating radial dot backgrounds or pseudo-element dot grid
rules.remedy: Remove nonfunctional decorative dot textures.

rules.title: Sparkle icons
rules.required_behavior: Remove decorative sparkles and magic-wand cues unless a genuinely necessary product action requires a specific symbol.
rules.detection: Sparkles/"magic" icons without task meaning
rules.remedy: Remove or use accurate action label/icon.

rules.title: Animated arrows
rules.required_behavior: Do not use perpetual arrow bounce, nudge, or hover gimmicks as a substitute for navigation clarity.
rules.detection: Continuously animated arrows or CTA nudge loops
rules.remedy: Remove ornamental motion, retain functional state transitions.

rules.title: Sparkle icons (repeated)
rules.required_behavior: Same policy as #24. Tracked for input completeness, implemented as one shared rule.
rules.detection: Alias of FF-024
rules.remedy: No second independent detector.

rules.title: No privacy policy
rules.required_behavior: **Require an accessible, accurate privacy policy** for products collecting or processing personal data. Flag missing or unverifiable details for owner review.
rules.detection: Personal-data flow and missing or dead privacy disclosure link
rules.remedy: Flag blocker/needs review; owner must supply accurate policy facts.

rules.title: Neon colors
rules.required_behavior: Avoid fluorescent accents and glowing outlines as a general design system.
rules.detection: Fluorescent/neon accents and widespread outer glows
rules.remedy: Shift to accessible, brand-suitable accents without neon glow.

rules.title: Basic single-color palettes
rules.required_behavior: Avoid lazy monochrome defaults. Use a coherent neutral foundation and a small set of complementary, purposeful accents, without turning it into a rainbow.
rules.detection: One-color default palette with no purposeful visual hierarchy
rules.remedy: Add coordinated neutral, text, surface, and limited accent roles.

rules.title: Unprofessional overall result
rules.required_behavior: Enforce coherent design, real content, working interactions, responsiveness, accessibility, performance, and visual consistency.
rules.detection: Aggregate quality failures across visual, functional, a11y, performance, and credibility checks
rules.remedy: Generate report and plan based on concrete sub-findings, never taste-only score.
